units.source_text: 崖上笼罩着乳白色的雾，起伏不定，打着涡旋。

en.t: A milky white mist hung over the cliff, rising and falling, swirling in eddies.

units.source_text: 夜之残余，仍然像冻住似的留下了阴影的部分……

en.t: The remnants of night still left patches of shadow behind, as though frozen in place...

units.source_text: 像烧红的金属线般发光的部分……

en.t: Places that glowed like metal wires heated red-hot...

units.source_text: 成了光蒸气粒子流动的部分……

en.t: Places where particles of luminous vapor seemed to flow...

units.source_text: 那阴影的组合，满足于幻梦，也拨亮了无边无垠的空想。

en.t: That arrangement of shadows, content within illusion, also kindled boundless fantasies into brightness.

units.source_text: 不管你怎么瞧，都瞧不够。

en.t: No matter how long you looked, you could never see enough.

units.source_text: 这时，所有的瞬间，都充满了新的发现。

en.t: At that moment, every instant was filled with new discoveries.

units.source_text: 从现实的形体到还没有见过的奇异形体，在这里，决不会有毫无用途的事情。

en.t: From real forms to strange shapes never seen before, here there could never be anything wholly useless.
